cue: Invoking an unfamiliar workspace script (or any tool) for the first time, or after a first failure
lesson: Inspect the tool's interface (--help or source) before first use, and after any traceback change strategy instead of retrying the identical command
evidence: Contrast: a run invoked scripts/read_doc.py in default mode twice, hit the same traceback both times, and only recovered after separately inspecting flags (--in host) — repeated identical failures yielded no new information

cue: When a single read of an extracted source document gets truncated (large .docx/.pdf extractions)
lesson: Extract to a persistent scratch file, record its full size, and read it in tracked line-range chunks with a grep-built index — never draft from a partially-read source, and confirm full coverage before writing the deliverable
evidence: The INV component's chunked-extraction guidance directly remediated the observed failure of truncated reads losing the tail of large extractions (schedules, signature blocks, annexes with material terms), while the DOM memory entries added complementary sourcing/verification discipline

cue: Adopting guardrails for document-comparison deliverables where findings could be fabricated or one-sided
lesson: Require every discrepancy finding to cite both the controlling source and the deviating document at a specific location, and treat one-sided claims as unverified hypotheses rather than findings
evidence: Probe contrasts showed DOM's guardrails mitigated the reference's weaker sourcing coverage, while the INV tool-guidance candidate (neutral, no sourcing constraint) did not address it

cue: When invoking an unfamiliar workspace script for the first time (or after it has failed once)
lesson: Inspect the tool's interface (--help or head of source) before invoking, and if it tracebacks, change a flag or mode rather than retrying the identical command
evidence: Probe contrasts showed that probing the reader script's interface before use eliminated wasted failed tool calls (the script required --in host and its default mode tracebacks), while unprobed invocations burned calls on repeated failures

cue: Producing legal or regulatory deliverables (e.g., impact memos, gap analyses) where claims must trace back to source documents
lesson: Enforce per-provision pin cites and explicit separation of sourced facts, analysis, and assumptions — content requirements, not formatting, are what fix citation defects
evidence: Reference memo cited figures and gaps without pin cites and blurred sourced facts vs. counsel analysis; the guardrails run enforced shorthand source definitions, pinpoint statutory/contractual cites, and Analysis/Assumption separation, visibly fixing the defect

cue: Drafting a review deliverable from large extracted source documents (e.g., legal review memos from contracts, playbooks, deal documents)
lesson: Persist each source to a scratch file, read it fully in tracked chunks (coverage ledger), and confirm 100% coverage before drafting — never draft from partial or truncated tool output
evidence: The reference run drafted the issues memo from truncated extractions (~36K chars lost on the playbook) and missed mechanical errors (wrong notice email, blank dates, mis-identified merger sub), while the candidate with full-coverage discipline caught them; the harness edit adopting coverage ledgering was retained over the alternative

cue: Drafting legal or financial deliverables from large deal documents (memos, payoff letters, gap analyses)
lesson: Before drafting, verify complete coverage of every source document via a coverage ledger (source, extracted length, sections read), and never fill gaps with plausible-looking numbers — label derived amounts as computed, separate sourced facts from analysis and assumptions, and pin-cite every figure and legal conclusion
evidence: The reference run's executive summary presented uncited 'estimates' and blended counsel analysis with sourced figures, while the adopted DOM guardrails' per-figure pin cites, sourced-vs-assumed separation, and confirmation protocol directly target those failures; INV's tool guidance was neutral because truncation persisted in both runs, showing the coverage-ledger discipline was the differentiator

cue: Reconciliation or tie-out work where findings assert discrepancies in source schedules
lesson: Require independent recomputation (re-footing) of any schedule before reporting a discrepancy, and pin-cite both source positions with the dollar delta — never conclude from eyeballed or truncated extractions
evidence: The reference run reported bridge footing failures from truncated extractions without re-footing; the candidate run with the guardrail independently re-footed schedules, pin-cited findings, and quantified a corrected EBITDA gap (−$1.3MM) versus the headline −$4.5MM

cue: When a reference output exhibits a specific, documented failure mode (e.g., uncited verbatim quotes across truncated sources) and multiple candidate guardrail edits are proposed
lesson: Adopt the edit that directly mitigates the observed failure mechanism (here: source-discipline rules forcing pin cites, re-checked quotes, and facts/analysis/assumption separation) over domain-generic edits, even when the latter show neutral contrasts
evidence: The INV guardrail's contrast showed it mitigating the reference's dozens of unverified findings and verbatim quotes, while the DOM candidate showed a neutral contrast on the same content — so the mitigating edit beat the keep baseline

cue: When a task requires complete coverage over a listing or corpus that tools may return truncated
lesson: Persist full listings/outputs to scratch files first and derive all counts and coverage claims from those files, never from partially-seen tool output
evidence: Both probe runs hit the same truncated-listing failure; the edit forcing persisted scratch inventories with verified counts fixed it, while the alternative guardrail edit regressed and produced no deliverable

cue: Any memo or analysis built from tool-extracted documents reports counts, figures, or citations
lesson: Require per-finding pin-cites to both sides (controlling source and deviating document) plus a coverage ledger confirming full extraction reads before drafting; treat single-sided or memory-derived claims as unverified hypotheses
evidence: The reference trajectory asserted tier counts (11/12/7) and dollar impacts ($126M, $28.3M, $61.7M) from partially-truncated extractions with no per-finding pin-cites, while the unmitigated alternative showed the same truncation pattern with neutral deliverable quality — the guardrail (pin-cites + coverage ledger + sourced/computed separation) is what distinguishes the two

cue: Producing compliance gap analyses or similar audit reports from multi-document extractions
lesson: Require dual pin cites plus recomputation of every count and figure before findings are reported — single-sided citations, paraphrased quotes, and summary counts that don't tie to the findings table are the dominant failure mode in truncated-extraction audits
evidence: Probe contrast: runs without the DOM guardrails asserted counts and figures from truncated extractions without dual pin cites or census-derived computation, while guardrail-driven runs did not differ on the deliverable, isolating citation/compute discipline as the operative protection

cue: Long document-review tasks with multiple required file deliverables and tool-dependent extraction
lesson: Persist extractions to scratch files and start producing deliverables by a fixed budget midpoint, rather than iterating on analysis until the run ends with no output
evidence: The reference run failed via a failing script, truncated single read, and no deliverable; after adopting persisted-extraction and deliverable-first-budget guardrails the failure mode was mitigated, while the neutral component (DOM) left the outcome unchanged, indicating the guardrails' discipline—not document handling—drove the improvement

cue: When deliverables are drafted from large tool extractions that may be streamed or truncated
lesson: Persist every source extraction to a file and read it fully in recorded chunks with a coverage ledger before drafting; derive all quotes, counts, and citations from the persisted files, never from stream memory
evidence: Probe contrast showed drafted register/memo content diverging from source when drafted from truncated stream output, while runs that persisted outputs and verified chunk coverage caught obligations concentrated in late appendices that truncated streams missed

cue: Whenever a run pipelines documents or commands through conversion/extraction scripts and the output feeds downstream analysis
lesson: Verify extraction output by content and size (grep for Traceback, check wc) before using it; on failure, read the named cause and switch tools (harness read, pandoc, python-docx) rather than retrying the same failing command with cosmetic changes like a new filename, and keep scratch files inside workspace-relative paths
evidence: Reference run repeatedly retried a failing read_doc.py with only a filename change and produced 18-line traceback files (1.6KB output for a 44KB source), plus wasted actions on /tmp permission-blocked reads; the adopted variant that mandates extraction-success checks and tool-switching produced the deliverable while the comparison run regressed to none

cue: Any multi-document task where intermediate extractions or scratch files are written before drafting
lesson: Persist all intermediate extractions to workspace-relative scratch files with stable names and verify their size/content before relying on them, rather than streaming one-shot tool output or writing outside the workspace
evidence: The reference's /tmp writes were unreadable due to permission-scoped read tool and its flag-retry flailing wasted execution; the adopted workspace-relative verified-scratch guidance mitigated both, while the already-sourced reference made pin-cite guardrails neutral

cue: Any task whose findings depend on reading multiple source documents end-to-end, especially with flaky extraction tooling and potentially truncated streamed output
lesson: Persist every document extraction to a verified workspace scratch file and complete a full-read ledger before drafting; treat any claim not traceable to a verified extraction as unsupported
evidence: Probe contrasts showed a prior run drafting from streamed/truncated output and partially-read sources produced unsupported assertions and missed findings (expired-policy renewal gap, unproduced diligence items), while the same failures (tracebacks, 0-byte extractions) were recoverable by error-driven tool switching and size/content verification of persisted extractions

cue: Drafting or reviewing legal documents from tool-extracted .docx/.eml/.pptx sources
lesson: Never draft from streamed extraction output or memory of partial reads: persist every extraction to a workspace file, verify it succeeded, and read it completely before citing or summarizing it
evidence: Probe contrast showed truncated-read drafting and a mis-retried extraction were the failure modes; enforcing persist-then-verify extraction remediates both, while neutral tool guidance changed nothing

cue: Long-document comparison or review tasks where documents are extracted via streaming tool output before analysis
lesson: Persist every extraction to a workspace-relative scratch file, verify it by content, and read it fully before drafting findings — never analyze from streamed or partially-read output
evidence: The stream-memory-based reference run produced 25 deviations with single-sided citations, while the persist-then-read run surfaced 40 deviations with dual pin-cites covering all DOA categories

cue: Any task that ingests multi-page source documents via tool calls before drafting deliverables
lesson: Persist each document's full extraction to a workspace scratch file and verify it (size, no errors, tail landmark present) before analyzing; never draft from streamed or partially-read tool output
evidence: The probe contrast showed the reference run's extraction-to-truncation failure — reasoning from a partial stream silently produced unsupported claims — which the adopted INV change fixes by requiring persisted, verified scratch files before analysis

cue: When a task requires traceable analysis of attached source documents via tools that stream (possibly truncated) output
lesson: Persist every document extraction to a workspace file before analyzing, and draft only from the persisted copy — never from streamed tool output or repeated failed reads
evidence: The reference run repeatedly retried failing read_doc.py calls and drafted from truncated streamed output, whereas the run with extraction-persistence guidance recovered quickly and produced an equivalent deliverable

cue: When a task requires synthesizing figures or facts from multiple long attached documents (e.g., memos, workbooks) before drafting a deliverable
lesson: Persist every extraction to disk with completeness checks (error grep, size, tail landmark) and read fully in chunks, drafting only from a verified coverage ledger — never from memory of streamed tool output
evidence: The one-shot streamed reference truncated mid-extraction and its memo repeated the damages workbook's uncorrected $11.78M–$18.83M totals, missing the $1,287,500 press and destroyed die sets, while the persist-and-verify candidate caught the omissions and corrected exposure to ~$13.07M–$20.12M

cue: When multiple candidate fixes target different components/files with no overlap
lesson: Merge complementary candidates rather than choosing one; disjoint changes capture all mitigations without conflict
evidence: The INV candidate (guardrails.md, deliverable-completion discipline) and DOM candidate (memory.md, extraction/computation traceability) each mitigate the reference run's zero-deliverable failure via different components, and the merge captured both fixes without overlap

cue: Multi-document deliverables that compare a corpus against enumerated categories (e.g., subpoena gap analyses) using streamed tool output for long extractions
lesson: Persist extractions to disk, verify completeness before citing, and build a request-by-request coverage matrix with recomputed arithmetic and pin cites before drafting prose
evidence: The INV candidate's streamed-output truncation and blind retries degraded the memo, while the DOM candidate's matrix-plus-reconciliation discipline produced the richer memo; merging both fixed distinct failure modes
